answer: Each operator stakes 25 POA for twelve epochs and completes five separate jobs, each judged by three randomly assigned reviewers with no shared funder and no overlapping review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The chain exposes the pattern: a walnut shell of hollow history cannot fake tenure, a terrace of graded reputation tiers gates premium work, and a meadow of independent reviewers proves real verification. Every extra sybil needs its own stake, jobs, and reviewers, so cloning costs more than it returns.
